input.content:
-- Backfill: due_date for existing tasks
-- Hand-written SQL; the review-gated Prisma schema is not modified here.
-- The due_date column itself was added in 20240215104500_add_task_due_date.
-- Idempotent: every statement guards on "due_date" IS NULL, safe to re-run.
-- Transaction is managed by scripts/backfill.ts (do not add BEGIN/COMMIT here).

-- 1. Completed tasks are due on the day they were completed.
UPDATE "tasks"
SET "due_date" = "completed_at"
WHERE "due_date" IS NULL
  AND "status" = 'DONE'
  AND "completed_at" IS NOT NULL;

-- 2. Everything else (including DONE rows with no completed_at) gets a
--    7 day window measured from creation.
UPDATE "tasks"
SET "due_date" = "created_at" + INTERVAL '7 days'
WHERE "due_date" IS NULL;
